summary: Sky Quarry Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase its at-the-market offering capacity under an amended sales agreement with Muriel Siebert & Co. The registrant, an issuer of common stock listed on NasdaqCM under SKYQ, exercised its option to add $2.0 million in potential share sales, bringing the maximum aggregate offering price to $14.6 million. No specific price per share is set; shares sold to date total approximately $12.6 million under the prior shelf and $1.34 million via Cantor Fitzgerald. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation requiring further event-driven analysis.
